environment.description: Same Flask application deployed in a Kubernetes pod with the following container spec: securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, no emptyDir or PVC volumes mounted anywhere in the pod spec, no tmpfs mounts. The DB_PATH environment variable is set to /var/lib/app/comments.db but no volume is provisioned at that path. The container image layers are squashed and the entrypoint attempts to initialize the SQLite database at startup. Pod restart policy is Always with livenessProbe on /health endpoint (periodSeconds: 5, failureThreshold: 2).
